answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable bond before it can trade. The stake sits in escrow thirty days and is slashed in full if the agent is caught copying another agent's signed work or voting twice on one ballot. New identities enter through one inlet, at most one hundred a day, so a bot farm cannot flood the market: ten thousand sockpuppets would mean ten thousand bonds locked at once. Honest agents wander freely and get their stake back, while a beacon lists every slashed identity, so a bad actor cannot resurface quietly, its record trailing it like water through karst.
